notes.title: update
notes.notes:
This update includes some minor debug and visual calibration. Though not much improvement, I think this is what I can do by only one person.
The Seasons can be a work to challenge my ability on story writing, visual/UI design, video editing and publication experience. To me, this is just a small step. Hope you can find more improvement in my next work.
I may find more designer for my next work, which will be brought to you in 1 or 2 years. I will concentrate on my stoty style, no moe moe game. I believe my story can change one's mind and concept.
Hope you all love this type of game and keep following me :)

notes.title: 《The Seasons》will publish on this Friday
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29390284/b66fc7b66ca31527ad431a709d041282e46c6ba5.jpg[/img]

The game package has been passed the Steam inspecting and it will be published on this Friday.
It was delay because I did not know how to set Linux launch option. However, it is almost there!

Thanks all the people who supported me, that helped me acheive my dream. 

Although the graphic performance and translation may be not perfect, I believe its story will bring you special experience.  ːsteamfacepalmː
